host_service_fee.notes: Standard host booking fee, charged at checkout.

vendor_commission_tiers.notes: Commission-only figures are approved. Monthly subscription prices are NOT approved for the Bros AI Concierge to quote — see vendor_plan_pricing below.

vendor_plan_pricing.notes: Do not quote a monthly price (e.g. the previously used $9.99/5% combination is not confirmed current). The Bros AI Concierge should say pricing details are provided during vendor onboarding.

promotional_offers.notes: The Bros AI Concierge must never mention any of these unless this file is updated to status: approved with an explicit value.

checkout_mode.notes: Hosts pay in full at checkout. Do not describe deposits, installment plans, or partial payment.

vendor_payout_trigger.notes: Vendor is paid after the event: released when host marks the event complete, or automatically after 7 days if the host takes no action. Do NOT say vendors receive an advance or deposit before the event — that website language is outdated.

payout_timing_details.notes: Exact processing windows and dispute-hold exceptions await final approval.

stripe_required_for_requests.notes: Vendors must complete Stripe identity verification before they can receive Party Bros host requests.

support_contact.notes: Internal lead/support notifications go to the STAFF_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL env var, never hard-coded.

approved_marketplace_metrics.approved_public_language: Party Bros is building a growing network of event vendors across North, Central and South Jersey.
approved_marketplace_metrics.notes: Do not state exact vendor counts (e.g. '35+ vendors', '1,000+ vetted vendors'). Metric categories to track separately once wired up: total_accounts, verified_vendors, active_vendors. Never describe a registered account as verified or bookable without the verified_vendors flag.

suppressed_claims: vendors get paid a deposit or advance up front
founding-vendor discounts or free-year offers (unless approved above)
